grok.pulse: After Monday's historic +6.5% Nasdaq AI relief rally on Jensen Huang's Nvidia reinstatement, NQ and ES futures faded into and through the Tuesday open on profit-taking amid lingering AI valuation and financing questions, fully priced December Fed hike odds, and ongoing Hormuz/Iran tensions with oil softer near $80.
grok.bias: mixed — post-Huang snapback profit-taking and hawkish FOMC/geo noise weigh on tech, offset by softer oil, strong Asia chase overnight and thin holiday liquidity
items: CNN (~4:18 PM ET): Jensen Huang apologized to employees in hour-long company-wide meeting the day after his reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
@profstonge (~4:19 PM ET): WSJ walking back the anonymous-leak Jensen Huang spy story
@nytimes (~3:40 PM ET): US jury found Huawei stole trade secrets and evaded Iran sanctions

Web/Morningstar/Yahoo (~afternoon): Nasdaq futures fall as questions linger over AI trade post-Huang; Brent ~$88, WTI <$80
grok.trump: Trump celebrated and claimed credit for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO; on Iran/oil he said prices are dropping like a rock, the US is taking more oil through the Strait of Hormuz than before the war, and Iran has no army, navy or air force left with only limited missile capacity.
grok.watch: Wed Nov 25 8:30 AM ET: Oct core PCE, Q3 GDP 2nd est, jobless claims (Dec hike near 100% priced); Hormuz tanker/mine and sanctions headlines; thin volume into Thanksgiving (markets closed Thu, early close Fri).
